blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in New Horizons rose from 5 in June to 6 in September (+20.0%), and 6 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 1.4% of Coquitlam’s 425 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in New Horizons?
New Horizons also had 29 condos and townhomes listed and 4 sold in September, against 6 houses listed. The New Horizons condos and townhomes page has those figures.

faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 6 houses listed in New Horizons. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is New Horizons a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in New Horizons had a sales ratio of not published for the month. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in New Horizons from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 6 houses sold in New Horizons over those 4 months, out of 219 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in New Horizons?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
